images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE full-bleed opaque landscape 3:2 environment illustration for a premium Egyptian fantasy mobile RPG BOSS BATTLE ARENA. Painterly semi-realistic hand-painted game art, beautifully weathered stone, detailed gold and bronze materials, cinematic atmospheric lighting. Environment ONLY, no character or creature anywhere, no human or animal statues, no text, no UI, no writing. Important playable composition: the rear wall meets a broad continuous flat tiled floor at 32 percent of image height. The lower TWO THIRDS is clear unobstructed battle floor with readable receding perspective tiles, dry and well illuminated enough for a monster sprite. Central foreground must be COMPLETELY EMPTY: no treasure, pillars, altar, staircase, podium, furniture, central magic circle, hazard or prepainted character shadow. A large boss sprite will stand at 84 percent image height in the center. Architecture and dramatic storytelling confined to rear wall and outer edges. Frame the centered space elegantly. Keep all rear decoration in upper third, avoid a tall feature continuing into combat floor. Rich restrained palette, readable subdued background not overblown. Theme: Obsidian Hall of Judgment, an ominous black basalt Egyptian royal judgment hall. Massive dark columns with restrained gold inlay at outer edges, a closed monumental black-and-gold double gate on back wall, abstract feather and balance-scale reliefs, icy teal soul-flame braziers at extreme edges, warm bronze rim light. Broad graphite stone floor with subtle blue reflections. Majestic and threatening, distinct silhouette, cold black/teal/gold palette.
